subject: ACME MAP - mutual action plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Reyes <john.reyes@acme.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ACME MAP - mutual action plan & next steps

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking time today. Appreciate the candid rundown of the environment and goals — summary below so we have a single source of truth and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please confirm or edit anything I missed.

Quick recap of pain points / goals
- High latency on conversational features during peak EMEA hours (~1.2s token latency currently impacting user experience).
- Cost unpredictability when batch sizes fluctuate; want to bring down per-token spend without sacrificing quality.
- Need deployment option that meets ACME security posture (VPC + KMS) for production PII flows.

Primary goals
1) Reduce tail latency to <= 400ms median for NLU endpoints.
2) Reduce inference cost by ~30% via batching/quantization and caching.
3) Validate Private (VPC) deployment with customer-managed KMS for regulated workflows.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (milestones, owners, dates)
- Milestone 1 — Proof of Concept (POC) setup: Redwood hosted POC using sample traffic + logging.
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
  - Stakeholders: John Reyes (ACME), Sandra Miller (Procurement)
  - ETA: start the week of 2026-08-24; 2 weeks for baseline + tuning

- Milestone 2 — Performance optimization & cost report:
  - Owner: Redwood Infra team (Vivek to lead)
  - Deliverable: latency & cost breakdown, recommendations (batching, quant profiles)
  - ETA: 2026-09-07 (1 week after POC completes)

- Milestone 3 — Security review & Private deployment evaluation:
  - Owner: ACME Security + Redwood solutions
  - Deliverable: checklist (VPC, KMS, audit logs), SOC2 evidence bundle if needed
  - ETA: 2026-09-14 (concurrent with legal review)

- Milestone 4 — Commercial/contracting:
  - Owner: ACME Procurement (Sandra) + Redwood Sales (Marissa)
  - Deliverable: PO/SOW sign + DocuSign
  - Target: week of 2026-09-20

Decision process & stakeholders
- Technical sign-off: John Reyes (Engineering Lead) + ACME Security (TBD)
- Procurement & budget: Sandra Miller (Procurement) — PO required
- Exec sponsor: CTO (informal)

Risk / open questions
- Will ACME need an on-prem package or will VPC be sufficient?
- Legal: expected to take ~2 weeks for SOW redlines per your note — confirm if longer.

Attachments & links
- I've attached a short POC proposal and estimated effort: [Attachment: redwood-map-proposal.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
- HubSpot MAP/record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME
- DocuSign placeholder for SOW: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/placeholder

Next steps (for this week)
1) Can you confirm the POC start date (we tentatively set Mon 2026-08-24)?
2) Please share the engineering contact for access to sample traffic and any compliance contacts who should be included.
3) Sandra — if you're on this thread, could you share PO timing / procurement cadence so we can align dates?

Thanks — I'll kick off internal scheduling once I have confirmation.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: redwood-map-proposal.pdf]
